profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello,
My name is Pedro Rivera, a lead software engineer at the US Naval Oceanographic Office. With a strong background in modernizing and maintaining mission-critical software, I have worked extensively on legacy systems used in both aircraft and large-scale data processing applications.

My expertise lies in optimizing performance, enhancing system reliability, and integrating modern technologies into legacy software. I am passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that make a real difference for our customers.

Let’s connect—I’d love to chat about software engineering and how we can use technology to simplify and improve our customers' lives.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: John C Stennis Space Center Mississippi  · On-site
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer of multiple large data processing projects 
• Led multiple large data processing projects by planning, developing, testing, and/or documenting software modifications.
• Researched and designed architectural overhaul of legacy systems for modernization efforts.
• Recommended and planned new modernization initiatives to enhance system reliability.
• Assisted and trained team mates on various software related topics.
• Assisted and led in interviewing potential candidates.
• Investigated and resolved any software bugs or related issues.
• Assisted in the creation of documentation of existing legacy systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: John C Stennis Space Center Mississippi  · On-site
positions.description:
Software Engineer on large data processing project
• Planned, developed, tested, and documented modifications to data intensive systems.
• Researched alternatives and produced technical documentation for requested modifications.
• Assisted in interviewing potential candidates for software engineering roles.
• Recommended and planned new modernization efforts to increase reliability of the system.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.locationName: Warner Robins, Georgia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developer/Build Manager of Embedded Device OFP Development Team Spin-up
• Led the integration of Agile processes into our Software Development Lifecycle.
• Developed build requirements and build process for the device.
• Led recurring management meeting to provide a progress report for the project.
• Collaborated with the device’s manufacturer to replicate their development environment. At this
event, I was able to successfully generate the first government software build of the OFP 6 months
ahead of schedule.
Lead Developer of Application Modernization
• Designed the architecture for a multi-million dollar suite of applications.
• Led the integration of Agile processes into our Software Development Lifecycle.
• Led the effort to re-host a suite of legacy desktop applications to C#.
• Developed GUIs with a focus in responsiveness while retaining a similar user experience to the
legacy system.
• Developed a CSV replacement for multiple proprietary file formats that have led to a reduction in
read times by over 100%.
• Developed backend functionality for multiple applications.
• Created a C# build tool to simplify the build process and reduce build times by over 100%. Lead Developer of Legacy System Modification
• Led the effort to update our software suite to be compatible with a next generation sensor.
• Developed changes to the software to account for new sensor timing requirements.
• Developed tools to allow for backwards compatibility with legacy data files.
• Supported end-users by leading the development of a high-priority update. Developer for DevSecOps project
• Researched the available software and features of DevSecOps and how it applies to non-standard
workloads.
• Produced documentation to assist future efforts in the use of DevSecOps.
• Vetted software for its usability in various new/on-going projects.
positions.insights: Delphi Pascal, Azure DevOps Server and +14 skills

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.locationName: Baton Rouge, Louisiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
January 2019 – May 2020
• The goal of this project was to create a decentralized system to allow users to rent computer time
from other users to train machine learning models. We utilized the Ethereum blockchain to facilitate the interactions and payments between users. Docker was used to containerize the Tensorflow models written in Python.
Publication
• Caleb Johnson, Tao Lu, Pedro Rivera, Devon McDonald, Samuel Pritchett, and Lu Peng. “iChain:
Peer-To-Peer Machine Learning Powered by Blockchain Technology.” frontiers in Blockchain, 12
July 2021.
• https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fbloc.2021.676159/full
positions.insights: HTML, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +2 skills
